baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins supposition, hearts, disease, causative bringing-out, and concealed rancors.
baseline_models.mechanism: An inward faculty contains a disordered disposition; divine causative extraction transfers its rancors from hidden interior to available evidence. The opening interrogative rejects the occupants' estimate that concealment can remain permanent.

activation_trace.role: Supposition and inward estimation supply the mistaken expectation that the concealed state will not be exposed.
The heart as inward faculty supplies the locus in which the hostile disposition is held.
Departure from health and balance makes the concealed disposition an active disorder rather than neutral privacy.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the transition from latent rancor to disclosed evidence.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely says that people with sick hearts harbor grudges which God knows.
changed_reading.after: The verse targets a theory of permanent interior concealment: a disordered inward state is treated as extractable and destined to become evidentially exterior.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The interrogative use of حَسِبَ governs the claim that God will never bring the rancors out.
baseline_models.mechanism: The occupants have made a failed estimate about divine scrutiny. Counting, practical inspection, and inquiry branches make حَسِبَ more than casual thought: their confidence in opacity is a bad account that the act of extraction will falsify.

activation_trace.role: Counting and accounting cast the rejected supposition as a miscalculation about what can remain unreckoned.
Practical inspection of an affair supplies an audit-like dimension to the divine challenge.
Seeking news and testing what a person contains makes their presumed secrecy vulnerable to inquiry.
Extraction from concealment is the result that disproves the failed account.

changed_reading.before: They simply think exposure will not happen.
changed_reading.after: They have mispriced the reach of scrutiny: the question anticipates a practical audit in which what they counted as hidden becomes extractable evidence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُلُوبِهِم مَرَضٌ places the disease in a locus whose root also carries turning and reversal, before يُخْرِجَ marks a boundary crossing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interior is not a static sealed container. The heart is a turning locus, its disease weakens or leaves an affair unformed, and extraction moves the result across an inside-outside boundary; rancor can therefore mature, reverse, or leak into a new state.

activation_trace.role: Turning a thing from one face to another makes the heart an unstable locus capable of reversal.
Weakening an affair and curtailing movement supplies an unresolved disposition whose outward action is compromised but still live.
Passing from a location or state to its outside supplies the threshold crossing by which the latent becomes manifest.

changed_reading.before: The rancor is a fixed object stored inside an equally fixed heart.
changed_reading.after: The heart-disease complex is dynamically unstable; extraction names a state change in which incomplete inward hostility crosses into outward form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated heart-disease formula in 47:20 is followed immediately by a visible, death-struck gaze when fighting is mentioned. This gives extraction a somatic route: pressure makes the concealed disorder leak through involuntary appearance before any confession.

activation_trace.role: The repeated heart as inward faculty identifies the same concealed locus under an external demand.
Weakening and curtailed movement supply the faltering response that becomes visible under pressure.
Disclosure from concealment receives a concrete channel in the involuntary bodily sign.

structural_cues: 47:20 repeats 'those in whose hearts is disease' and immediately describes their gaze when fighting is mentioned.
47:21 contrasts acceptable speech with truthfulness once the affair becomes resolved and demanding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated heart-disease formula and a visible collapse under pressure; I infer that pressure externalizes the inward aversion. A live alternative is that the gaze shows fear alone and that the rancors are exposed later by another route.

changed_reading.before: God's bringing-out is an unspecified future disclosure.
changed_reading.after: Disclosure can already occur as involuntary somatic leakage when a demand forces the diseased interior to react.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby possibility of corruption and severed kinship gives the hidden rancor a social output. What is extracted from the heart is not only an emotion or proposition; it can become a relation-breaking practice.

activation_trace.role: Abandonment and cutting a bond supply the concrete social form that concealed hostility can take.
The inward heart locates the latent disposition before it becomes relational conduct.
Departure from balance links the inward disorder to destructive rather than neutral social action.

structural_cues: 47:22 pairs corruption in the land with severing womb-relations.
47:23-24 continue from social damage to disabled perception and locked hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacent corruption and kin-severing; I infer that extracted rancor can be the latent mechanism realized in those acts. A live alternative is that 47:22 is a separate warning and does not specify the content of أضغان.

changed_reading.before: Rancor is private antipathy that becomes known.
changed_reading.after: Rancor is also stored relation-breaking capacity whose extraction can be read in corruption, abandonment, and severed bonds.

context_deltas.mechanism: Locks on hearts and self- or satanic embellishment describe an interior that both closes and supplies itself with persuasive cover. Divine extraction therefore becomes a breach of self-sealing and self-description, not merely the reporting of an openly held feeling.

activation_trace.role: The repeated heart supplies the interior faculty on which the following closure operates.
Closure, hardness, and dryness make the interior resistant to reflection and ordinary access.
Embellishment by the self or Satan supplies an internal narrative that masks and sustains the backward turn.
Extraction from concealment becomes the counter-operation that defeats closure and masking.

structural_cues: 47:24 asks whether locks are upon hearts rather than treating failed reflection as lack of information.
47:25 places backward movement after guidance beside embellishment and delay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heart-locks and embellished regression; I infer a self-sealing mechanism that extraction must defeat. A live alternative is that the locks concern non-reflection generally while 47:29 concerns a narrower group and a different disclosure process.

changed_reading.before: The hidden rancor simply waits inside until God announces it.
changed_reading.after: The rancor is protected by closure and persuasive self-cover, so bringing it out is a breach of the very mechanism that keeps the diseased heart unreadable to itself and others.

context_deltas.mechanism: Secret partial obedience to those who hate the revelation, followed by the polarity of pursuing displeasure and hating approval, turns rancor into covert alignment. The concealed content is not merely affect; it is an operative preference that negotiates allegiance and selects an opposing direction.

activation_trace.role: Hiding a thing in the interior supplies the covert layer beneath the spoken promise of partial obedience.
Penetration into hidden affairs supplies divine access to the covert alignment despite its secrecy.
Displeasure as the opposite of approval gives the concealed hostility a directional affective pole.
Approval opposed to displeasure supplies the positive pole that their aversion rejects.
Acceptance as the contrary of displeasure preserves the second mapped reading and sharpens rancor as refusal of acceptance.
The heart anchors those covert preferences in the focus ayah's interior locus.

structural_cues: 47:26 reports a promise to obey those who hate what God sent down in part of the affair, then states that God knows their secrets.
47:28 pairs following what provokes displeasure with hating divine approval.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a secret partial-obedience pact and an explicit displeasure/approval polarity; I infer that the rancors include actionable allegiance and not only private resentment. A live alternative is that the secret and the rancor are related symptoms without being identical contents.

changed_reading.before: أضغانهم denotes a concealed hostile feeling.
changed_reading.after: The concealed hostility has political and behavioral structure: it negotiates partial obedience, aligns with opponents of the revelation, and chooses displeasure over approval.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah distinguishes direct showing from recognition by marks and by the inflection or drift of speech. Bringing out rancors can therefore be distributed across readable signs: body, wording, tone, and the indication carried by speech, without requiring an explicit confession.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark supplies one outward surface on which concealed disposition becomes readable.
A sign by which something is known preserves the alternate mapped root and reinforces recognition through evidence.
Speech bent toward its implication supplies disclosure through phrasing that points beyond its explicit content.
Formed tone and vocal pattern supply an audible channel for the latent disposition.
The indication carried by speech makes the utterance itself evidence beyond its propositional surface.
Bringing the hidden into view is revised from one announcement into a semiotic disclosure process.

structural_cues: 47:30 first names the unrealized possibility of direct showing, then says they will be recognized by their marks and in the inflection of speech.
47:30 closes with divine knowledge of works, widening the evidential field beyond words.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct showing as a counterfactual and recognition through marks and speech as actual channels; I infer that these channels can realize the preceding promise to bring rancors out. A live alternative is that 47:30 only teaches the addressee recognition while divine extraction remains a separate future act.

changed_reading.before: God will expose the rancors by a singular direct disclosure.
changed_reading.after: The extraction can be semiotic and distributed: concealed hostility writes itself into visible marks, verbal slant, vocal tone, and works that become recognizable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Testing until distinctions become known and testing the community's reports supplies an epistemic procedure. Trial does not create the inward disposition; it applies conditions under which latent commitments produce differentiating evidence.

activation_trace.role: Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the pressure-to-evidence mechanism of extraction.
Examination that reveals the condition preserves the second mapped root and the same disclosure-through-trial possibility.
Knowledge of a report and an affair's interior links observable reports back to concealed reality.
Extraction from concealment becomes the result produced evidentially by trial.

structural_cues: 47:31 repeats testing and places it before knowing those who strive and endure.
The same ayah makes reports or disclosed records an object of testing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, differentiating knowledge, and tested reports; I infer an arrow from imposed trial to outward evidence of an already latent disposition. A live alternative is that the trial establishes a public record without functioning as the specific extraction promised in 47:29.

changed_reading.before: Divine knowledge makes any procedure of exposure unnecessary.
changed_reading.after: The ayah can distinguish prior divine knowledge from enacted disclosure: trial converts hidden commitments into differentiating evidence and a public report.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence supplies a concrete elicitor. Wealth becomes the object at stake; insistent asking activates stinginess; the exact bringing-out-of-rancors wording recurs; spending and refusal then sort the community, with replacement as the terminal consequence. The focus extraction is therefore also an economic stress test of allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Possessed wealth supplies the concrete valued resource around which the hidden disposition is pressured.
Exhaustive insistence supplies the pressure that pushes a latent response into action.
Stinginess is the immediate behavioral symptom elicited by pressure on wealth.
The repeated extraction verb explicitly carries the rancors from concealment into manifestation.
A due or amount brought out from wealth creates a cross-domain bridge between financial exaction and extracted hostility.
Money going out in expenditure supplies the demanded outward transfer against which inward attachment is tested.
Repeated stinginess turns a momentary reaction into a diagnostic pattern that rebounds upon the self.
One group standing in place of another supplies the communal consequence after the hidden disposition becomes behaviorally legible.
Accounting recasts the focus supposition as a failed estimate about what a demand on wealth will reveal.

structural_cues: 47:36 juxtaposes reward with the statement that their wealth is not being asked for.
47:37 gives a conditional sequence from insistent asking to stinginess and repeats the focus wording 'bring out your rancors'; the branchless ض غ ن recurrence is used structurally only.
47:38 moves from the call to spend through repeated stinginess to the possibility of communal replacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies wealth, insistent asking, stinginess, the exact extraction-of-rancors recurrence, spending, and replacement; I infer that financial pressure is one enacted means by which 47:29's latent hostility becomes public allegiance data. A live alternative is that the agent of extraction remains directly divine while economic pressure is only the occasion, not the causal instrument.

changed_reading.before: The mode and occasion of bringing out the rancors are left wholly unspecified.
changed_reading.after: A later lexical echo specifies one powerful mode: pressure on valued wealth elicits stinginess, exposes hostile attachment, and makes communal loyalty sortable enough for replacement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it materializes moral hostility as a bodily lesion. It remains anchored in the focus ayah's heart, disease, and extraction roots, including the explicit branch of a sore emerging from the body. Downstream prose should present it only as a medical-material analogy for pressure and surfacing, not as a claim that أضغان literally denotes an abscess.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ayah places disease in hearts and uses a causative extraction verb for the rancors.

activation_trace.role: Disease specifically affecting the heart intensifies the focus ayah's medical localization.
Bodily illness and departure from health supply the lesion-like disorder.
A sore or swelling emerging in the body supplies the strange but coherent image of inward hostility erupting to the surface.

changed_reading.before: Exposure is informational: a hidden attitude becomes known.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, exposure resembles a diseased swelling forced outward: the rancor is a symptom that the disordered interior cannot indefinitely contain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the interrogative and extraction through inquiry and game branches rather than ordinary disclosure language. It remains anchored in the exact focus roots and is strengthened by the following trial vocabulary. Downstream prose should qualify it as a procedural analogy for testing concealed stakes, not as the lexical definition of the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حَسِبَ and يُخْرِجَ frame a disputed expectation about whether hidden contents can be made to appear.

activation_trace.role: Inquiry that tests what is with a person supplies the probing side of a concealment contest.
The game of making someone reveal what is in the hand supplies a compact image of compelled disclosure.
Testing that makes a state appear gives the concealment-game analogy a contextual procedure.
The alternate mapped examination branch likewise supports disclosure of a condition through testing.

changed_reading.before: The people passively wait for a unilateral revelation of their interior.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are already in a failed concealment contest: inquiry and trial compel the hidden stake to be shown despite their confidence that it can stay in hand.

strongest_changes: The exact focus wording recurs in 47:37 inside a conditional chain from pressure on wealth to stinginess and exposed rancor, specifying an economic elicitation mechanism.
47:30 changes bringing-out from a single announcement into distributed recognition through visible marks, verbal slant, tone, and works.
47:31 distinguishes prior knowledge from enacted evidence: trial makes latent commitments differentiating and reportable.
47:26-28 expands rancor from private emotion into covert obedience and directional allegiance against divine approval.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah sits between a backward chain of locked hearts, secret alignment, and affective opposition and a forward chain of marks, speech-signals, testing, and finally an exact lexical echo under financial pressure. Those chains preserve several coexisting modes of extraction: breach, leakage, semiotic recognition, trial, and economic elicitation.
remaining_uncertainties: The economic sequence clearly provides the occasion for extraction, but the precise causal division between divine agency, insistent demand, and elicited stinginess remains open.

The adjacency of corruption, locked hearts, secret obedience, and the focus group strongly supports continuity, but the packet does not force every description to have exactly the same human referent.
No branch inventory is supplied for ض غ ن, so its recurrence can anchor structure and lexical identity but cannot support an invented mapped root or branch citation.
The lesion and concealment-game readings are branch-grounded analogies whose explanatory value may exceed their lexical probability.
